title: ML Applications & Domain Problems
blurb: Recommenders, time series, search ranking, explainability, GNNs, audio classification, tabular deep learning.

lecture.summary: Apply the full ML/DL toolkit to real-world domains — time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, medical imaging, recommender systems, NLP for code, graph neural networks, semi-supervised & multi-task learning, and fairness/bias — on synthetic domain datasets throughout.
takeaways: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and recommender systems.
Graph neural networks, medical imaging, and NLP for code.
Fairness/bias, semi-supervised, and multi-task learning on domain problems.

snippet.caption: A GNN layer: aggregate neighbors, then transform.
snippet.code:
# the same learning idea, retargeted to graphs
h_v = relu(W @ mean([h_u for u in neighbors(v)] + [h_v]))
